mapper.select: WITH class1_scores AS ( SELECT s.score FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND st.class_id = #{class1Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL ), class1_ranked AS ( SELECT score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM class1_scores ), class1_median AS ( SELECT AVG(score) AS medianScore FROM class1_ranked WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((total + 1) / 2), CEIL((total + 1) / 2)) ), class1_stats AS ( SELECT 'class1' AS classTag, ci.id AS classId, ci.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, AVG(s.score) AS avgScore, STDDEV(s.score) AS stdDevScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.score) * 100 AS passRate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN class_info ci ON st.class_id = ci.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND ci.id = #{class1Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ci.id, ci.class_name ), class2_scores AS ( SELECT s.score FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND st.class_id = #{class2Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL ), class2_ranked AS ( SELECT score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM class2_scores ), class2_median AS ( SELECT AVG(score) AS medianScore FROM class2_ranked WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((total + 1) / 2), CEIL((total + 1) / 2)) ), class2_stats AS ( SELECT 'class2' AS classTag, ci.id AS classId, ci.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, AVG(s.score) AS avgScore, STDDEV(s.score) AS stdDevScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.score) * 100 AS passRate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN class_info ci ON st.class_id = ci.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND ci.id = #{class2Id} AND s.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ci.id, ci.class_name ) SELECT cs.*, cm.medianScore FROM class1_stats cs, class1_median cm UNION ALL SELECT cs.*, cm.medianScore FROM class2_stats cs, class2_median cm

SELECT s1.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, c1.id AS courseId, c1.course_name AS courseName, s2.score AS prevScore, s1.score AS currentScore, (s2.score - s1.score) AS dropAmount FROM score s1 INNER JOIN score s2 ON s1.student_id = s2.student_id INNER JOIN course c1 ON s1.course_id = c1.id INNER JOIN course c2 ON s2.course_id = c2.id AND c1.course_name = c2.course_name INNER JOIN student st ON s1.student_id = st.id WHERE s1.create_time > s2.create_time AND s1.score IS NOT NULL AND s2.score IS NOT NULL AND (s2.score - s1.score) > #{threshold} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score s3 INNER JOIN course c3 ON s3.course_id = c3.id WHERE s3.student_id = s1.student_id AND c3.course_name = c1.course_name AND s3.create_time > s2.create_time AND s3.create_time < s1.create_time ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score_alert sa WHERE sa.student_id = s1.student_id AND sa.course_id = c1.id AND sa.prev_score = s2.score AND sa.current_score = s1.score )
